title: Vyasa Intent Object
description: What the user wants, described before anything is done about it. Produced by the NLU layer (keyword matcher or LLM), consumed by auth and the executor. See INTENT_CONTRACT.md.

action.description: The kind of operation. Must be one the executor has a handler for, or 'unknown'.

target.description: What the action applies to. Null for actions that take no target, such as screenshot or battery.

params.description: Extra data the action needs. Free-form by design: a search needs a query, a future browser click needs a selector.

confidence.description: How sure the producer is. 1.0 is an exact phrase match. Below config.MIN_CONFIDENCE the caller should ask the user to repeat rather than guess.

raw_text.description: Exactly what was heard or typed. Kept for logging and for telling the user what was misunderstood.

source.description: How the command arrived. Typed commands cannot be voice-verified, so this affects authentication.

engine.description: Which NLU produced this intent. Lets you measure how often the LLM beats the keyword matcher.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601, second precision. Set when the intent is created.

sensitive.description: Whether this needs speaker verification before running. Derived from the action; shutting down qualifies, scrolling does not.

examples.raw_text: can you shut the computer down please
